---
title: "Stablecoins — compare USDC, USDT and DAI transaction sizes and volumes"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE, message = FALSE)
```

We want to compare three major Ethereum stablecoins:

- USDC (smart contract address: 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48)
- USDT (smart contract address: 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7)
- DAI (smart contract address: 0x6b175474e89094c44da98b954eedeac495271d0f)

We will investigate two questions:

1.  How do their transfer sizes differ?
2.  How much transfer volume does each stablecoin generate?

Our workflow is:

``` text
Ethereum
   ↓
Etherscan
   ↓
ERC-20 transfer events
   ↓
R / tidyverse
   ↓
transfer sizes + transfer volumes
```

We use Etherscan to retrieve the already indexed ERC-20 transfer events. Etherscan’s `tokentx` endpoint can be filtered directly by token contract, so we do not need to download unrelated ERC-20 transfers first.

We use the term transfer rather than transaction throughout the lab: one Ethereum transaction can generate several ERC-20 transfer events.

## Our solution

```{r}
readRenviron(".Renviron")
api_key <- Sys.getenv("ETHERSCAN_API_KEY")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)

addUSDC <- "0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48"
addUSDT <- "0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7"
addDAI <- "0x6b175474e89094c44da98b954eedeac495271d0f"
```

Requests (same block window for all tokens, all pages):

```{r}
start_block <- 21000000
end_block <- 21000300

get_transfers <- function(address) {
  pages <- list()
  for (p in 1:10) {
    r <- request("https://api.etherscan.io/v2/api") |>
      req_url_query(
        chainid = 1,
        module = "account",
        action = "tokentx",
        contractaddress = address,
        startblock = start_block,
        endblock = end_block,
        page = p,
        offset = 1000,
        sort = "asc",
        apikey = api_key
      ) |>
      req_perform() |>
      resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)
    if (!is.data.frame(r$result)) break
    pages[[p]] <- r$result
    if (nrow(r$result) < 1000) break
    Sys.sleep(0.5)
  }
  bind_rows(pages)
}

r_USDC <- get_transfers(addUSDC)
r_USDT <- get_transfers(addUSDT)
r_DAI <- get_transfers(addDAI)

write_rds(r_USDC, "r_USDC.rds")
write_rds(r_USDT, "r_USDT.rds")
write_rds(r_DAI, "r_DAI.rds")
```

Data frames:

```{r}
df_USDC <- read_rds("r_USDC.rds")
df_USDT <- read_rds("r_USDT.rds")
df_DAI <- read_rds("r_DAI.rds")

df_USDC <- df_USDC |>
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value)/10^6)
df_USDT <- df_USDT |>
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value)/10^6)
df_DAI <- df_DAI |>
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value)/10^18)

head(df_USDC, n=5)
head(df_USDT, n=5)
head(df_DAI, n=5)
```

### 1. 

We want to see how much the transfer sizes differ across the stablecoins.

For each token we compute the mean and the median transfer size:

```{r}
data.frame(
  name = c("USDC", "USDT", "DAI"),
  mean_size = c(
    mean(df_USDC$value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(df_USDT$value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(df_DAI$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  median = c(
    median(df_USDC$value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(df_USDT$value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(df_DAI$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)
```

```{r}
df_all <- bind_rows(df_USDC, df_USDT, df_DAI)

df_all |>
  filter(value > 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tokenSymbol, y = value, fill = tokenSymbol)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Transfer size comparison (zero-value transfers excluded)",
    x = "Token",
    y = "Transfer Size (USD, log10 scale)"
  ) 
```

The same boxplot on the raw scale (zero-value transfers excluded):

```{r}
df_all |>
  filter(value > 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tokenSymbol, y = value, fill = tokenSymbol)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Transfer size comparison, raw scale (zero-value transfers excluded)",
    x = "Token",
    y = "Transfer Size (USD)"
  )
```


Histograms of the transfer sizes on the log scale, with the median (solid line) and the mean (dashed line) of each token:

```{r}
df_pos <- df_all |>
  filter(value > 0)

stats <- df_pos |>
  group_by(tokenSymbol) |>
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value),
    median_value = median(value)
  )

ggplot(df_pos, aes(x = value, fill = tokenSymbol)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~tokenSymbol, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = median_value)) +
  geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = mean_value), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Transfer Size (USD, log10 scale)", y = "Transfers")
```


USDC has the highest median transfer size (about 900 USD), then DAI (about 830), while USDT has the lowest (about 490). All three are right-skewed: on the raw scale the boxes are squashed near zero because of a few outliers reaching millions of USD, and the mean is far above the median. On the log scale the boxes look roughly symmetric, and USDC and USDT have outliers at both ends (tiny transfers and huge ones). The histograms show the same thing: bell-shaped on the log scale, with the mean (dashed) far to the right of the median (solid), because a few huge transfers pull the mean up. DAI looks irregular because it has only 138 transfers, so its numbers are less reliable. This is just a short window of blocks, not the whole history of the tokens.

### 2. 

```{r}
df_all |> 
  group_by(tokenSymbol) |> 
  summarise(transfer_volume_tot = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE))
```

To calculate the transfer volume for each stablecoin, we compute the sum of all transfer amounts grouped by token. In the block window analysed (21000000-21000300, same for all tokens), USDC generates the highest volume (about 81M), followed by USDT (about 67M) and then DAI (about 5.6M). These are volumes for this short window only, not for the whole history.
